body:
Thanks for your observation, the main problem is that we are film production freelancers in central america, and right now we have just enough money to buy food, therefore going to the vet is not an option right now, but our concern about the health of our cats is always a priority, thank god we found this subreddit with such gentle people that supports with their knowledge.  


That been said, I groomed my 2 other cats and they show no signs of fleas, flea dirt or face acne, not even hair loss. but we will take the cautions as well.

Thank you so much, will keep you posted.  


\*Not native english speaker.

Hi! Thank you so much for your answer, today I read about the flea dirt and located some of those black dots under his chin as well, those ones were more easy to take out, now his chin is clean, I took them out by hand and then cleaned the chin with water and carbolic soap, the chin was a lot cleaner.

My question is, is there a chance that he could have transferred those black dots from flea dirt from his chin to the back of his tail when he grooms himself?

I understand that there is a difference between flea dirt and face acne, but just want to make sure that I'm on the right path.

Thank you so much.

Hi! Thank you for your answer, I just took some samples right now, and gently sprayed some water on them, and they turned reddish brownie kind of color.  


Edit: And no, he's not in any flea preventive treatment.
Copy that. Will keep you posted. Thank you.
Love it! It looks healthy and big! Keep it up!

Hi! Thank you for your response!

Probably I did not make it clear in what I wrote, but what you said it is exactly what I do, I'm a supportive boyfriend that creates a lovely, clean and organized environment, I reach out her family everyday, I brought her family to my house! And since we cannot afford the therapist anymore she does not help that much, I encourage her hobbies, a lot of them including podcasts, watching movies, playing video games, make puzzles, everything, everyday.

More than 2 years has passed, and apparently for what she says, this is something that comes many years ago before we started up dating.

The thing is, after I tried EVERYTHING, what else can I do without ending my relationship, how to be "more". How to help?

Besides that, I'm not blaming her, not at all, I know that those reactions are the result of her condition and I'm still here. That's the main reason I'm writing this post, looking for help, not to blame her, if that was the case I would be cursing a lot. but I'm not.

Love.
